info.title: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics public API (yorishiro kami spec)
info.description:
Hand-authored OpenAPI 3 spec for the BLS publicAPI v2 timeseries endpoint. BLS does not publish OpenAPI; this is the etzhayyim-side canonical surface. Reference: https://www.bls.gov/developers/api_signature_v2.htm

A registration key extends the daily query quota but is optional. To pass it, include `registrationkey` in the request body.

post.description: POST a list of BLS series ids and an inclusive year range. Returns the requested observations keyed by series id under `Results.series[]`. Unauthenticated calls are rate-limited to 25/day per IP and to a 10-year max range; authenticated calls (with `registrationkey`) extend to 500/day and 20 years.

startyear.description: Inclusive lower bound (4-digit year, string form per BLS contract).

registrationkey.description: Optional BLS API registration key (extends quota).

catalog.description: If true, includes series metadata catalog in the response.

calculations.description: If true, includes 1/3/6/12-month percent change calculations.

schema.description: { status, responseTime, message, Results: { series: [{ seriesID, data: [{year, period, periodName, value, footnotes }, …] }] } }.
